property_summary: For any deposit d and withdrawal a with 0 < a <= d, a user can always collect their entire remaining credit afterwards via refund() (which transfers the true recorded balance and succeeds); the mutant never decrements on withdrawal, so refund() attempts to transfer more ETH than the contract holds and reverts for every a > 0.
change_summary: Delete the balance-decrement statement so the caller's recorded balance is never reduced on withdrawal.
